Delta_m32_squared_IO.convention: m3^2-m2^2, inverted ordering; quoted scale factor S=1.3.

W_over_Z.convention: Direct ratio row of the PDG boson summary. The separate W/Z rectangle test does not assume a covariance for this row.

m_beta.convention: Tritium beta-decay effective mass, m_beta^2=sum_i |U_ei|^2 m_i^2. This is not three measured individual masses.

top_direct.convention: Direct reconstruction mass. Its Monte-Carlo/kinematic interpretation is not silently equated with the pole mass.

u_over_d.convention: Ratio of same-scale MSbar light-quark masses.

conjugate_mass_policy: The standard comparison uses the common particle/conjugate mass parameter in the usual CPT-symmetric description. Repeating that parameter is not a claim of separate measurements of every conjugate or color coordinate.

H.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
H.convention: Reconstructed Higgs mass summary, compared with the specified perturbative Higgs pole calculation; quoted PDG scale factor S=1.5.

W.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
W.convention: Conventional W Breit-Wigner mass parameter; excludes the CDF AALTONEN22 value in this PDG average.

Z.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
Z.convention: Z Breit-Wigner resonance parameter. PDG footnote [e] distinguishes it from the complex propagator-pole convention.

b.convention: MSbar self-scale mass m_b(mu=m_b); not the bottom pole mass.

c.convention: MSbar self-scale mass m_c(mu=m_c); not the charm pole mass.

d.convention: MSbar quark mass at renormalization scale 2 GeV, in the stated low-energy quark-mass convention; not a constituent or pole mass.

e.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
e.convention: Physical electron mass (on-shell/pole mass convention), not an MSbar running Yukawa coefficient.

gluon.convention: PDG explicitly labels gluon mass zero a theoretical value. Eight color-adjoint components do not supply eight separately measured free-particle pole masses.

mu.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
mu.convention: Physical muon mass (on-shell mass convention), not an MSbar running Yukawa coefficient.

nu1.convention: Individual neutrino mass eigenvalue not determined. The beta-decay effective-mass limit and oscillation differences are separate observables.

nu2.convention: Individual neutrino mass eigenvalue not determined. The beta-decay effective-mass limit and oscillation differences are separate observables.

nu3.convention: Individual neutrino mass eigenvalue not determined. The beta-decay effective-mass limit and oscillation differences are separate observables.

photon.confidence_level: not specified in the summary mass row
photon.convention: Photon mass bound; zero is the massless gauge-theory value, not an experimentally resolved nonzero mass.

s.convention: MSbar quark mass at renormalization scale 2 GeV, in the stated low-energy quark-mass convention; not a constituent or pole mass.

t.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
t.convention: Top pole mass extracted from cross-section measurements; the comparator for the source's specified QCD4/EW2 pole output.

tau.confidence_level: quoted error; no new statistical interpretation
tau.convention: Physical tau mass (on-shell mass convention), not an MSbar running Yukawa coefficient.

u.convention: MSbar quark mass at renormalization scale 2 GeV, in the stated low-energy quark-mass convention; not a constituent or pole mass.
